newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to discuss revised "C" sugar forecast.
newsitem.headline: EU to discuss revised "C" sugar forecast.

text.p: A revised forecast for carry-over non-quota "C" sugar into the 1997/98 marketing season is due to be discussed for the first time by the European Union's sugar management committee on Wednesday, an EU official said on Monday.
Figures showing an increase to 917,000 tonnes from 890,000 tonnes forecast last month were presented by the European Commission at last week's meeting.
"Revised forecasts were presented to the meeting last week but there was no time for discussion. The new figures are due to be discussed for the first time on Wednesday," the official said.
Last week the Commission also raised its forecast of "C" sugar exports to 2.44 million tonnes in 1996/97 from a previous forecast of 2.28 million tonnes.

EU beet sugar production was estimated at 16.52 million tonnes in 1996/97 compared with 16.34 million tonnes forecast last month and a final figure of 15.56 milion tonnes in 1995/96. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
